compile.local_part: minimum H/S word on each qubit, then an exact dynamic-programming schedule that batches all currently-ready equal H or S operations; objective lexicographically minimizes GR pulses, local-Rz site requests, then layer count
compile.H_layer: frozen 8-live-data selective-H construction using two GR pulses plus target/spectator Rz echoes
compile.S_layer: parallel local Rz(pi/2) on the selected target set

permutation_modes.gate_SWAP: minimum transposition decomposition, SWAP=3 CNOT, CNOT=H_target CZ H_target
permutation_modes.transport: ideal instantaneous atom-role permutation for unitary stress; report moved roles and permutation cycles, but assign no transport error/timing because MOVE channel is source-open

finite_pulse_model: same PRX-2025 timing + npj-2025 coherent-error cross-profile stress frozen previously
metrics: average gate infidelity over signed cycle
claim_rule: transport mode may remove gate-control burden but cannot become a hardware advantage claim until MOVE timing/error/loss are source-bound
